summary.text: Allan Howland is a Democratic state representative for New Hampshire House of Representatives Strafford 20 who took office in December 2022 and is seeking re-election in the November 3, 2026 general election. He is a former high school science teacher.

paragraphs.text: Howland earned a B.S. in biology from Hobart College and an M.S. in education from Northern Illinois University.
His career experience includes working as a high school science teacher.
He has served on the Oyster River School Board and the Durham Town Council and as chair of the Oyster River Finance Committee and the Durham Economic Development Committee.
Howland defeated Mark Racic in the Strafford 20 general election on November 8, 2022, and defeated Joseph Rowell in 2024; he succeeded Tom Southworth in the seat.
He was assigned to the Municipal and County Government Committee for the 2023-2024 session.
John Colford (R) is his opponent in the November 3, 2026 general election.
